name: fx_bat9
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/bat9_lake.state (the Diablos fight in the Cathedral's inner hall, loc 082, Crono's command menu up): bat9_lake's walk into the ambush, from cathedral_hall with the party the owner's game brought there poked in first -- the sheet bytes that game's own fights left (Crono 34/83 HP, 2 MP and his experience bytes, Lucca 48/75 HP, Marle's HP), the bag (Pendant, Heal), 925 G, the persistent RNG cursor $29AD = 86 and the play clock (8:42:12, so that it reads the capture's 8:42:18 here). A recipe cannot replay that history; everything else is played.
